title: LLV-GBANK-RATIONAL-LOGELASTIC: linear classical memory and refined cube-root source copies

claims.statement: For every N>=2 and s in Z/NZ, n=ceil(log2N), the ONE physical LLV-GBANK-RATIONAL-LOGELASTIC interpreter in proof.md executes the full scoped GPS-RATIONAL-LOGELASTIC program in virtual.md with fixed p=3,q=1,beta=1/8,eta=1,gamma=-15/16. It recovers the whole secret from independent ideal copies with unconditional success at least1-2^-8. For n<2^9216 it executes the exhaustive finite branch; otherwise v is the least integer with v^3>=n^2, ell=ceil(log2n), h is the least integer with h^8>=ell, b=ceil(v*(4ell+6h-48)/3), m=ceil((n-1)/b). Every profile/source/decoder/precision/acquisition/fallback quantity is recomputed. Jointly on EVERY branch including failed work, wrong labels, both aborts, source moves, padded growth and output-first cleanup, time T is O(2^((2/3)n^(2/3)*log2n+n^(2/3)*(log2n)^(1/8))) with exact growth index2/3. All constants are absolute. The counted CQ interpreter preserves the virtual output law and source-request sequence; its polynomial overhead is paid within the internal3n^(2/3) time margin. All padding, basis/coherent/source wires, metadata, generation, arithmetic, addresses, reset and cleanup count jointly with success, both physical spaces, source cap and clean fraction0. Virtual memory columns are not used as physical bounds.

For this same physical LLV-GBANK-RATIONAL-LOGELASTIC algorithm/configuration, the guaranteed malformed-source fraction is epsilon(n)=0 under the exact independent-ideal-copy model. For every N>=2 and every secret, all acquired copies are independent ideal coset states and full-secret recovery succeeds with unconditional probability at least1-2^-8 jointly with all four physical resource bounds. The bank simulation preserves the complete output and source law under this promise. Additional bank measurements may expose classical record bits under a different adaptive supplier model, for which no transfer or positive tolerance is claimed. Zero is not an impossibility assertion about greater robustness.

structured.error_model: Malformed fraction among acquired copies. The proved guarantee requires every copy to be an independent ideal coset state; no behavior is promised for malformed copies.
